summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the sulphur/sulphuric-acid chokepoint. The strongest underfollowed candidates are not necessarily miners; they sit in chemical distribution, inland/coastal liquid logistics, and byproduct-acid smelting. The provided Kpler context frames the shock as a 2026 acid/sulphur trade-route disruption affecting Chilean copper SX-EW, Indonesian HPAL nickel, and fertilizer supply.
